name: index_access_grants
sql:
CREATE TABLE index_access_grants(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(substr(id,1,4)='grt_' AND length(id)=36 AND substr(id,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 host TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(host)=64 AND host NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
 revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN(0,1)), provenance_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reviewed'
 CHECK(provenance_kind IN('reviewed','imported_legacy')), import_upgrade_id TEXT
 CHECK(import_upgrade_id IS NULL OR length(import_upgrade_id)=32 AND import_upgrade_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), import_plan_digest TEXT
 CHECK(import_plan_digest IS NULL OR length(import_plan_digest)=64 AND import_plan_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), import_legacy_binding TEXT
 REFERENCES legacy_index_projects(legacy_binding) ON DELETE RESTRICT, import_configuration_digest TEXT
 CHECK(import_configuration_digest IS NULL OR length(import_configuration_digest)=64 AND import_configuration_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
 CHECK((provenance_kind='reviewed' AND substr(id,5,1) IN('0','1','2','3','4','5','6','7')
     AND import_upgrade_id IS NULL AND import_plan_digest IS NULL
     AND import_legacy_binding IS NULL AND import_configuration_digest IS NULL)
   OR (provenance_kind='imported_legacy' AND substr(id,5,1) IN('8','9','a','b','c','d','e','f')
     AND import_upgrade_id IS NOT NULL AND import_plan_digest IS NOT NULL
     AND import_legacy_binding IS NOT NULL AND import_configuration_digest IS NOT NULL))) WITHOUT ROWID

 CHECK((policy_epoch=0 AND policy_digest IS NULL) OR (policy_epoch>0 AND policy_digest IS NOT NULL)),

CREATE TRIGGER service_event_transition AFTER UPDATE ON service_jobs

    VALUES(CAST(unixepoch('subsec')*1000 AS INTEGER),NEW.project,'job_'||NEW.state,NEW.id,NEW.kind,NEW.epoch,NEW.attempts,

CREATE TRIGGER service_source_outcome_updated AFTER UPDATE OF state,outcome ON service_jobs
    WHEN NEW.state IN('succeeded','failed','canceled') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM service_job_source WHERE job=NEW.id)
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO service_source_outcomes(project,seq,job,state,outcome) VALUES(NEW.project,NEW.seq,NEW.id,NEW.state,NEW.outcome)
        ON CONFLICT(project) DO UPDATE SET seq=excluded.seq,job=excluded.job,state=excluded.state,outcome=excluded.outcome
        WHERE excluded.seq>=service_source_outcomes.seq;
    END
